name: two-implementations
title: Two implementations of mostly the same thing
part: For real: two forges, one vocabulary
html:
Two implementations of mostly the same thing

Same job: a change is proposed, merged by squashing, then commented on. Different words, numbers, fields and calls for nearly all of it.
say: Each forge's own page, as a visitor sees it, for the same release: a change proposed, merged by squashing, then commented on. The same job, done by both. Different names for nearly everything: pull request or merge request, # or !, the base or the target branch, a comment or a note.
